Build rules to add fd_resolv_tile to fd_discoh when FD_HAS_ALLOCA is set.

# Purpose
Builds `fd_resolv_tile` and adds it to `fd_discoh` only when `FD_HAS_ALLOCA` is defined. This conditional make logic controls whether the object is included in the build based on the availability of `alloca`.
